turns.input: I'm in the wrong account and can't see our church's songs. How do I change it?
turns.reply: Where are you seeing the account you’re signed into, and what screen are you on when the church’s songs are missing?

turns.input: I’m looking at the Planning Center website in Safari. That’s where I can’t see our church’s plan and songs.
turns.reply: Planning Center access and plan visibility are outside what I can change in Playback, so a specialist can help review the account or permissions. Would you like me to connect you with one now?

turns.input: I understand. I’ll contact our church’s Planning Center admin about the login and access.
turns.reply: Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Thanks so much for calling MultiTracks Playback support. Have a great day, and goodbye!
